about_the_game:
Blast off to Uranus to save Earth from the terrifying threat of the Vampire Pirates.

Travel to an alternate dimension where evil Vampires created a vast space station, ZetaZania, on Uranus.  A long time ago, their ruthless leader King Maximus launched a horrific mass kidnapping of humans to extract their blood, to make precious Life Elixir.  The highest ranks of the Vampire’s society indulge in the Life Elixir to live forever.

You are the highest-ranking officer in Earth’s military operation to destroy the Vampires’ threat to humanity.  You must travel to Uranus and blast your way through the Vampires’ ranks, starting at the lowest levels and working up to the Royal Palaces to annihilate King Maximus.

Some levels may prove a challenge as you find your way through maze-like rooms and locate the correct switches to unlock barriers.

Collect Power Crystals along the way to activate portals to advance between levels and to upgrade your arsenal to defend against the Vampires.

A retro-style 2D side-scrolling action-adventure platform game, featuring gameplay based on games from the 90s, with a modernised player control system.

Gameplay includes a classic action-packed style of jumping between platforms to shoot enemies with your handy blaster gun, whilst avoiding obstacles and solving puzzles to find your way to advance to the next level and upgrade your weapons.

You will be taken back to when games were simple, casual, character-driven and focused on exploration.

Shoot and jump your way to victory as you navigate 60 levels and defeat the evil Vampires throughout 7 different locations in the Vampire's vast space station.  Each location has its own monstrous boss.

You must save Earth!  You are humanity's last hope, our saviour and destroyer of Uranus.

content_descriptors.notes:
This game contains sexually suggestive imagery and language, sexual innuendo, heavily stylised 2D cartoon-style pixellated nudity in background artwork as well as mild cartoon-style violence and mild themes of horror.
Parental discretion is advised for younger players.
Please be aware of the game's themes and content before playing. Always ensure that the game is suitable for you or the intended player.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10 or later
  • Processor: Intel i3 or AMD Ryzen 3 (2 Core)
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Intel UHD Graphics or AMD Radeon Integrated graphics (with OpenGL 3.3 or Higher Support)
  • Storage: 3 GB available space
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10 or later
  • Processor: Intel Core i5 or AMD Ryzen 5 (Quad Core)
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce GTX 1050 (4GB) or AMD Radeon RX 560 (4GB)
  • Storage: 3 GB available space

short_description: A 2D sci-fi action-adventure side-scrolling platformer, with a rich storyline, immersive music and retro-style pixellated graphics. Featuring quirky British humour, challenging maze-like levels, complex visual puzzles and an in-game upgrades system to upgrade your arsenal to defend against enemies.
